verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, covered by its SLA. A migration skill for moving client code to the latest major version across ten languages points to actively versioned SDKs. On the framework side, React InstantSearch and InstantSearch.js are documented, and a community user praises React InstantSearch as easy to add. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of release cadence or how current each SDK is, framework coverage beyond React/vanilla JS, and independent corroboration of the backend-language SDKs.
